decision: Use one operator-provided ISHIKU_SETUP_SECRET for new installations and generate persistent internal session and credential-encryption keys under /data.
rationale: The ZimaOS profile requires a visible single setup-secret field in the primary Compose. Cookie signing and credential encryption are runtime implementation details and should not create two additional first-run steps.
compatibility: TUNIKU_REGISTRATION_SECRET_FILE and TUNIKU_REGISTRATION_SECRET remain supported as setup aliases.
TUNIKU_SESSION_SECRET_FILE and TUNIKU_SESSION_SECRET remain supported as runtime overrides.
TUNIKU_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE and TUNIKU_ENCRYPTION_KEY remain supported as runtime overrides.
Existing encrypted Gluetun credentials require the previous encryption-key override until they are cleared or saved again.
rollback: Restore the previous Compose secret mounts or set the retained legacy override variables; no database schema or stored data is rewritten by this decision.
